title: Anchoring Bias: A Persistent Fairness Backdoor Attack against MLLMs under Continual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.21577v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes domains where fairness is a critical safety requirement. In practice, these models are continually updated through continual learning (CL) to adapt to evolving tasks and data distributions. Prior work has shown that backdoor attacks can manipulate MLLM responses through hidden triggers, but naively implanted backdoors degrade as models undergo subsequent updates of CL. Although fairness has emerged as a central concern for MLLM deployment, whether backdoor-induced fairness violations can survive CL remains unexplored, leaving two critical questions unanswered: (1) whether a backdoor can reliably induce fairness violations in MLLMs, and (2) whether such fairness-targeted backdoors can persist through continual learning. We bridge this gap by proposing Persistent Fairness Backdoor Attack (PFBA) to inject persistent and group-specific discrimination into MLL

translated_title: 锚定偏见：多模态大语言模型在持续学习下的一种持久公平性后门攻击
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）越来越多地部署在高风险领域，其中公平性是一个关键的安全要求。在实践中，这些模型通过持续学习（CL）不断更新，以适应不断变化的任务和数据分布。先前的研究表明，后门攻击可以通过隐藏触发器操纵MLLM的响应，但简单植入的后门会随着模型经历后续CL更新而退化。尽管公平性已成为MLLM部署的核心关注点，但后门诱导的公平性违规是否能在CL中存活仍未被探索，留下了两个关键问题：（1）后门是否能可靠地诱导MLLM中的公平性违规，以及（2）这种针对公平性的后门是否能通过持续学习持久存在。我们通过提出持久公平性后门攻击（PFBA）来弥合这一差距，将持久且特定群体的歧视注入MLLM中。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新的持久公平性后门攻击（PFBA），证明后门引发的公平性违规能在持续学习过程中存活，并注入针对特定群体的持久歧视。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel Persistent Fairness Backdoor Attack (PFBA), demonstrating that backdoor-induced fairness violations can survive continual learning and inject persistent group-specific discrimination into MLLMs.
